text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fan letter addressed to Kitasan Black 
arrived. When I immediately head over to 
deliver it to her—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh, a fan letter for me!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy! May I read it right now? 
Let's see—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“Watching Kita-chan run made my heart 
pound, and it made me want to do my best 
too! I love you so much—!”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whoa... This feels kind of nostalgic!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've written a fan letter before 
too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "To Teio-san."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I love your races, Teio-san! They're so 
fun and thrilling—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And, one more thing... Hmm, what should I 
write?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I was so desperate to get my 
feelings across that I just ended up 
spinning my wheels.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I don't feel like I've managed to write 
even half of what I wanted to say...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It was a bit frustrating knowing that all 
I could do was cheer from the sidelines, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So it wasn't like that after all!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Because reading this letter just now made 
me realize it!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You spent so much of your precious time 
thinking so much about me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Their support, and their love for me... It 
came through more than enough...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Right now, I'm fully charged with power!
What is it~? That sounds like fun♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If you're that full of energy, hang out 
with me for a bit! I'm kind of in the mood 
for a run~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm on a whole 'nother level 
today~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Spurred on by this fan letter, Kitasan 
Black threw herself into her training with 
even greater zeal."
